main:1.text: In The Beginning... is the introduction sequence in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, which introduces the main characters and establishes the storyline. Forelli Crime Family Don, Sonny Forelli, his right-hand man, and another unknown Forelli member, discuss Tommy Vercetti's release from prison, after he was arrested and jailed for killing eleven men during a botched hit; serving fifteen years behind bars.

main:2.text: An Old Friend is the only storyline mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Forelli Crime Family Don Sonny Forelli. The mission is triggered from Tommy's suite in the Ocean View Hotel, located along Ocean Drive in Ocean Beach, Vice City. Tommy starts the mission outside Ken's office then heads to the Ocean View Hotel and goes upstairs to his hotel room.

main:3.text: The Party is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to the protagonist Tommy Vercetti by lawyer Ken Rosenberg from his office in Washington Beach, Vice City. Tommy Vercetti goes to Ken Rosenberg's office trying to find some leads, following the orders of Sonny Forelli.

main:4.text: Back Alley Brawl is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by lawyer Ken Rosenberg from his office in Washington Beach, Vice City. Rosenberg wants Tommy to find out more information about the ambushed drug deal. Rosenberg tells Tommy to meet Kent Paul, the biggest rumor guy in the city, at the Malibu Club, where he can usually be found.

main:5.text: Jury Fury is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by lawyer Ken Rosenberg from his office in Washington Beach, Vice City. Tommy drops by Ken's office in Washington Beach where Ken tells him that the Forelli Crime Family is angry that they do not have the family's money.

main:6.text: Riot  is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas that protagonist Carl Johnson performs independently at Madd Dogg's Crib in Mulholland, Los Santos, San Andreas. Frank Tenpenny, along with Eddie Pulaski, has finally been charged with racketeering, corruption, narcotics and sexual assault.

main:7.text: Four Iron is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by property developer Avery Carrington from his limo in his construction site in Vice Point, Vice City. Just like Avery's other missions, (Demolition Man and Two Bit Hit) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:8.text: Demolition Man is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by property developer Avery Carrington from his construction site in Vice Point, Vice City Beach, Vice City. Just like Avery's other missions, (Four Iron and Two Bit Hit) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:9.text: Treacherous Swine is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by retired army colonel Juan Cortez from his yacht docked in Ocean Bay Marina in Ocean Beach, Vice City. After receiving a phone call from Cortez for a job, Tommy meets Cortez at his yacht.

main:11.text: Guardian Angels is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by retired army colonel Juan Cortez from his yacht docked in Ocean Bay Marina in Washington Beach, Vice City. Cortez's good friend Ricardo Diaz has a deal to close with the Cubans, but he could use some extra security and wants Tommy to protect him.

main:12.text: The Chase is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by drug baron Ricardo Diaz from his mansion in Starfish Island, Vice City. Tommy visits Ricardo Diaz at his mansion on Starfish Island.

main:13.text: Phnom Penh '86 is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by drug baron Ricardo Diaz from his mansion on Starfish Island, Vice City. Diaz is aggrieved with some Streetwannabe's gangsters who are trying to defraud him. He orders Tommy to go to their hideout in Prawn Island and kill them. He wants Tommy to fly there, using the help of his associate, Lance Vance.

main:14.text: The Fastest Boat is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by drug baron Ricardo Diaz in from his mansion in Starfish Island, Vice City. Tommy arrives at Ricardo Diaz's mansion to find him shooting at pigeons with a shotgun for defecating on his car.

main:15.text: Supply & Demand is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by drug baron Ricardo Diaz from his mansion in Starfish Island, Vice City. Some freelancer moors his yacht into Vice City every month. The yacht is referred to as "The Drugboat", since the freelancer sells drugs from that boat.

main:16.text: Sir, Yes, Sir! is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by retired army colonel Juan Cortez from his yacht docked in the Ocean Bay Marina in Ocean Beach, Vice City. Cortez has a buyer who wants a "piece of military hardware", a tank. He wants Tommy to steal it and drive it to a lock-up in Little Havana.

main:17.text: Two Bit Hit is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by property developer Avery Carrington from his limo in his construction site in Vice Point, Vice City. Just like Avery's other missions, (Four Iron and Demolition Man) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:18.text: Death Row is the only mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Kent Paul. Tommy arrives at the Malibu Club and Kent Paul approaches him. Paul informs Tommy that Lance Vance tried to attack Ricardo Diaz but failed, and Diaz's men are now holding him hostage and torturing him at the Junkyard.

main:19.text: All Hands On Deck! is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by retired army colonel Juan Cortez from his boat docked in Ocean Bay Marina in Ocean Beach, Vice City. This mission can be played any time even after beating the main story.

main:20.text: Rub Out is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Lance Vance from outside Ricardo Diaz's mansion on Starfish Island, Vice City. Tommy decides to act on his plan to kill Diaz. He meets up with Lance on the bridge to Starfish Island, and Lance provides Tommy with an M4 carbine. They enter Diaz's Mansion and manage to shoot their way through the mansions gardens.

main:21.text: Shakedown is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City that the protagonist Tommy Vercetti performs independently in the Vercetti Estate in Starfish Island, Vice City. After taking over Diaz's mansion, Tommy discusses with Lance, Ken, and Avery on what to do next. Lance tells Tommy that some stores are refusing to pay protection money since Diaz's death.

main:22.text: Bar Brawl is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which protagonist Tommy Vercetti performs independently. The mission is triggered from the Vercetti Estate on Starfish Island, Vice City. Tommy enters his mansion and sees Lance Vance at the bar. Lance explains that the Front Page Café is refusing to pay protection because they are instead protected by a "local gang of thugs".

main:23.text: Cop Land is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which protagonist Tommy Vercetti performs independently. The mission is triggered from the Vercetti Estate on Starfish Island. At the Vercetti Estate, Mike and Lance are arguing about a failed bomb detonation at the Tarbrush Café in the North Point Mall. Tommy arrives and Lance explains the situation.

main:24.text: Stunt Boat Challenge is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Cubans leader Umberto Robina from his father's cafe in Little Havana, Vice City. Just like other missions for Umberto, (Cannon Fodder, Naval Engagement and Trojan Voodoo) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:25.text: Cannon Fodder is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Cubans leader Umberto Robina from his fathers café in Little Havana, Vice City. Just like other missions for Umberto, (Stunt Boat Challenge, Naval Engagement and Trojan Voodoo) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:26.text: Naval Engagement is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Cubans leader Umberto Robina from his father's café in Little Havana, Vice City. Just like other missions for Umberto, (Stunt Boat Challenge, Cannon Fodder and Trojan Voodoo) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:27.text: Juju Scramble is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Haitian gang leader Auntie Poulet from her home in Little Haiti, Vice City. Just like other missions for Auntie Poulet, (Bombs Away! and Dirty Lickin's) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story. Tommy is told to drop by Auntie Poulet's shack.

main:28.text: Bombs Away! is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Haitian gang leader Auntie Poulet from her home in Little Haiti, Vice City. Just like other missions for Auntie Poulet, (Juju Scramble and Dirty Lickin's) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story. Auntie Poulet wants Tommy to destroy a fleet of Cuban boats that are used to traffic drugs.

main:29.text: Dirty Lickin's is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Haitian gang leader Auntie Poulet from her house in Little Haiti, Vice City. Just like other missions for Auntie Poulet, (Juju Scramble and Bombs Away!) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:30.text: Trojan Voodoo is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Cubans leader Umberto Robina from his father's café in Little Havana, Vice City. This mission can only be accessed after Auntie Poulet's missions have been completed.

main:31.text: Love Juice is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by rock band Love Fist from their recording studio in Downtown, Vice City. Just like other missions for Love Fist (Psycho Killer and Publicity Tour) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story. Tommy meets up with Kent Paul and is introduced to the Love Fist band.

main:32.text: Psycho Killer is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to the protagonist Tommy Vercetti by the rock band Love Fist from their recording studio in Downtown, Vice City. Just like other missions for Love Fist (Love Juice and Publicity Tour) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:33.text: Alloy Wheels of Steel is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Bikers leader "Big" Mitch Baker from The Greasy Chopper bar in Downtown, Vice City. Just like Mitch Baker's other missions, (Messing with the Man and Hog Tied) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:34.text: Messing with the Man is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Bikers leader "Big" Mitch Baker from The Greasy Chopper in Downtown, Vice City. Just like Mitch Baker's other missions, (Alloy Wheels of Steel and Hog Tied) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:35.text: Hog Tied is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Bikers gang leader Mitch Baker from The Greasy Chopper in Downtown, Vice City. Just like Mitch Baker's other missions, (Alloy Wheels of Steel and Messing with the Man) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:36.text: Publicity Tour is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by heavy metal band Love Fist from their recording studio in Downtown, Vice City. Just like other missions for Love Fist (Love Juice and Psycho Killer) this mission can be played at any time even after beating the main story.

main:37.text: Checkpoint Charlie is an asset mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. It is available after the purchase of the Boatyard in Viceport, Vice City. The mission has six difficulties, becoming harder by changing the weather and time limit. Only the first one has to be completed to finish the asset though.

main:38.text: Distribution is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which Tommy Vercetti performs independently. This is the only asset mission for the Cherry Popper Ice Cream Company and is triggered from the company's factory in Little Havana, Vice City.

main:40.text: The Sunshine Autos Import Garage is a set of side missions for the Sunshine Autos asset in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. It is located in the small lower-level compound behind the main showroom, and is also the location of four two-car safehouse garages, a Pay 'n' Spray, and the Vice Street Racer checkpoint races.

main:41.text: Recruitment Drive is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by porn film director Steve Scott in InterGlobal Films in Prawn Island, Vice City.

main:42.text: Dildo Dodo is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by porn film director Steve Scott at the InterGlobal Films studio in Prawn Island, Vice City. Tommy Vercetti stops at the InterGlobal Films studio to learn of the upcoming film's progress.

main:43.text: Martha's Mug Shot is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by porn film director Steve Scott from the InterGlobal Studios in Prawn Island, Vice City. Congressman Alex Shrub wants to win the next election by supporting restrictions on the porn film industry. As this is bad for InterGlobal Films, Tommy wants to follow Candy Suxxx to Shrub.

main:44.text: G-Spotlight is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by film director Steve Scott from the InterGlobal Films Studio in Prawn Island, Vice City. To help promote the launch of the new film, the studio needs a big stunt. Steve reminisces how back in the day there were gala events, limos and searchlights.

main:45.text: V.I.P. is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to the protagonist Tommy Vercetti by dispatcher Doris from Kaufman Cabs in Little Haiti, Vice City. It is unlocked after the purchase of Kaufman Cabs. Doris states that a V.I.P. customer has asked for a ride to Escobar International Airport from his mansion in Starfish Island.

main:46.text: Friendly Rivalry is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Doris from the Kaufman Cabs depot in Little Haiti, Vice City. After taking a high class fare to the airport in the previous mission, Doris informs Tommy that due to the abundance of Vice City Cabs, Kaufman Cabs is losing business. Doris tells Tommy that he better do something before they lose business.

main:47.text: Cabmaggedon is the final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Doris from the Kaufman Cabs depot in Little Haiti, Vice City. Tommy will be told by Doris through the radio that Mercedes is asking for a pick up at Viceport. Tommy drives over to the large vacant lot by the docks. However, Mercedes is not there and it turns out to be a trap.

main:48.text: No Escape? is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which protagonist Tommy Vercetti performs independently. The mission is the first asset mission for the Malibu Club. Tommy needs a safe-cracker for the bank job he is planning. Ken Rosenberg suggests a man named Cam Jones. However, Jones is currently in police custody awaiting transfer, so Tommy decides to "parole" Jones.

main:49.text: The Shootist is a Malibu Club asset mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which the protagonist Tommy Vercetti does independently, located in Vice Point, Vice City. Tommy wants a stickup man for the job. Cam Jones recommends Phil Cassidy as he considers him to be one of the best shooters in town. Tommy heads to Downtown to a shooting range to meet Phil.

main:50.text: The Driver is a Malibu Club asset mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which protagonist Tommy Vercetti does independently, located in Vice Point, Vice City. Tommy, Ken and Phil are all in the club, with Tommy saying that the heist plan is coming together nicely, and the only thing left to do is to hire a driver. Ken suggests himself, but Phil suggests Hilary King, describing him as a great driver.

main:51.text: The Job is the last Malibu Club asset mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City that protagonist Tommy Vercetti does independently. Shortly after purchasing the Malibu Club, Tommy finds his team in order to pull of a heist at a bank in Little Havana. Tommy finds all of necessary positions for his team, and heads for the Malibu Club.

main:52.text: Gun Runner is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by arms dealer Phil Cassidy from his depot in Little Haiti, Vice City. After the successful bank heist, Phil phones Tommy saying he can receive some extra weaponry.

main:53.text: Boomshine Saigon is the second and final mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Phil Cassidy from his firearms business in Little Haiti, Vice City. Tommy goes to Phil's Place and finds a drunken Phil, who shows him his boomshine bombs. Phil presses the detonator as Tommy ducks down on reflex, but the bomb fails to detonate.

main:54.text: Road Kill is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Mr. Black from a payphone at the Washington Mall in Washington Beach, Vice City. Mr. Black contacts Tommy Vercetti after Jury Fury, believing him to be Leo Teal, a person who Tommy killed not too long ago, after learning he might have been involved in the ambushed deal Tommy participated in. Mr.

main:55.text: Waste The Wife is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Mr. Black from a public phone booth in Vice Point, Vice City. Mr. Black gets in contact once again with Tommy, thanking him for his earlier job well done. He then goes on to explain his next task, his employer wants his wife, Mrs. Dawson, dead.

main:56.text: Autocide is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Mr. Black from a public payphone outside the Washington Mall in Ocean Beach, Vice City. Tommy receives a phone call at a public payphone outside the Washington Mall and receives instructions from Mr. Black to kill members of a European gang, currently undercover in the city, before they rob a bank.

main:57.page: Check Out at the Check In
main:57.text: Check Out at the Check In is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Mr. Black from a payphone inside the terminal of Escobar International Airport, Vice City. Tommy goes to a payphone inside the airport terminal, and Mr. Black informs he has left him a sniper rifle to assassinate a businessman with a briefcase.

main:58.text: Loose Ends is the final job in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Mr. Black from a public phone booth near the Cherry Popper Ice Cream Factory in Little Havana, Vice City. Tommy answers the ringing payphone in Little Havana. Mr.

main:59.text: Spilling the Beans is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Print Works operator Earnest Kelly from the Print Works in Little Haiti, Vice City. After buying the Print Works, Tommy Vercetti meets Earnest Kelly, the former owner. Tommy explains that his father used to work in a print works and Tommy cleaned the rollers with him as a child.

main:60.text: Hit the Courier is a mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Earnest Kelly from the Print Works in Little Haiti, Vice City. After finding out about the counterfeit plates, Tommy sets out to intercept them from a courier landing in Viceport. After a brief conversation with Lance and Earnest, he leaves for Viceport.

main:61.text: Cap the Collector is the penultimate storyline mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City and the final mission given to protagonist Tommy Vercetti by Earnest Kelly from the Print Works in Little Haiti, Vice City. Sonny is getting impatient with Tommy since he never paid him the money which was lost during the drug deal. He is also angry that he has cut off all his connections with him.

main:62.text: Keep Your Friends Close... is the final storyline mission in Grand Theft Auto: Vice City which Tommy Vercetti performs independently from his mansion in Starfish Island, Vice City. After failing to forcibly tax Tommy's businesses, Forelli Crime Family Don Sonny Forelli is heading to Vice City from Liberty City in order to deal with Tommy in person and reclaim his "cut".
